race.comment: CUNNAMULLA FELLA (5) has returned in career-best touch this campaign and loves racing here. Gets a good pull at the weights over a few of his main dangers and draws the A1. Won't get too many better chances. NAILS MURPHY (7) made a strong return here three weeks ago when only warming late. Has a lot more to offer and Youngberry's 3kg claim could well prove the difference late. EXPRESS PAYMENT (1) is unbelievably consistent and is getting placed to perfection. Terrific record here and is sure to give his all but has to lug the big weight. CAPITAL ASSET (8) was too bad to be true last time at Eagle Farm but can bounce back sharply on the quick turnaround and give plenty of cheek in front. YET HE MOVES (2) will be hoping they overdo it in front so he can launch late - which he could well and truly do.
